specialty.description: A role that can edit the repository. Use engineer unless the team has another.

definition_of_done.description: Exact shell commands that prove the ticket worked, each one as a shell would run it, never a description.

inputs.description: Artifact pins: an id, @ and its version, then optionally # and a section's slug, its heading in lower case with hyphens. For example SPEC-M1@1#ac-1 or SPEC-M1@1#what-it-must-do.

target_artifact.description: The document id alone, such as SPEC-M1 or TEST-PLAN-M1, with no @version or #section.

target_section.description: The slug of the heading whose text you would replace, such as risks. Name this or target_ac, not both.

target_ac.description: A criterion id, such as AC-3. On a Spec, proposed_text is that criterion's new text, which the stakeholder decides. On a Test Plan, proposed_text is that criterion's new commands, one exact shell command per line.

proposed_text.description: The whole replacement for that section, criterion text or list of commands.

proposed_verification.description: Only with target_ac on a Spec: the one shell command its Verified by line should name instead, when that command is what is wrong. proposed_text still holds the criterion's text, word for word if only the command is wrong. On a Test Plan the commands are proposed_text, so leave this out.
